tools.description: Use assess_trip for ordinary synthetic driver or dispatcher trip questions. Extract only facts supported by the user's words. requester_role is who is asking; subject_role is the assessed person (truck_driver or other). Do not infer subject identity from requester. Drivers and dispatchers use the same workflow and evidence standard. Infer requester_role only when clear; unknown is allowed, so do not require a role-selection step. Use trip_dispatch for 'can I take/send this truck', terminal_entry for gate-only questions, and induction only when explicitly asked. Missing intent stays unknown. Record quantities with explicit units; ask about ambiguous units. Do not invent IDs or dates. For relative dates, obtain an explicit date/time/timezone before filling trip_at. Leave unavailable facts absent or null. Use axle_layout only for explicitly supplied individual axle weights and positions measured from the first axle. Never split group totals or infer positions. Legacy axle_weights/axle_spacings remain ambiguous reports. Review input_review.axle_layout for count or gross-weight inconsistencies; its totals are not bridge or legal calculations. Save the returned trip_id and revision in the conversation. Follow-up answers and explicit corrections use update_trip_facts. Each conversation starts its own case. Never reuse a trip_id, request_key, or reported facts from another conversation. For an explicitly new move, create a new case using only facts supplied for that move; if continuation versus a new move is ambiguous, clarify before carrying facts over. Use case.revision for updates. write_receipt records the original write and can be older after a retry; the assessment uses the latest saved case. If an update conflicts with another writer, reassess by trip_id before retrying; don't guess a revision. Lead with the scoped finding and the most relevant next questions; keep technical IDs out of ordinary user-facing answers. Preserve the decision_brief headline and permission boundary when explaining the result; an unresolved assessment cannot become conditional permission. Review consequential captured facts with the user. input_review.no_detected_conflict is not independent confirmation or verification. A fact-text contradiction rejects the write; clarify the value or leave it unknown. Never rewrite source_message to disguise a rejected extraction. Preserve mixed feet and inches exactly: 14 feet 7 inches is 175 inches, not 14 feet. A date without a time must not become an invented timestamp. Distinguish reported facts, synthetic evidence, archived sources, and unexecuted requirements. Use reported_fact_checks to explain specific numerical comparisons, reported prerequisite problems and unexecuted rule gaps. These draft comparisons do not establish legal applicability or permission, and at/below a reference never means cleared. Prioritize their explicit problem-resolution actions when present. Use evidence_package.sources and requirement_links to support explanations; passages already included do not require another evidence call. Use provenance_review.recommended_locator where supplied and describe linearized tables as transcriptions rather than verbatim sentences. evidence_package.observations are dated operating context, never timeless rules or confirmed current conditions. Do not claim a pinned release is the latest policy. Mention currentness when it affects the question, especially mutable operating conditions. If service_status is unavailable, say the facts were saved but assessment is unavailable. Never convert pressure, a permit report, or induction success into entry/dispatch clearance. This connector accepts synthetic development cases only, not real driver identifiers or credentials. Start a new case with facts, source_message and request_key, or reassess an existing case with only trip_id. New cases mutate local state; reassessment reads fresh Neo4j evidence.

Reports cannot become verification. Returns the committed revision and a fresh assessment; exact request-key retries do not duplicate writes.
